title: The dark note
goals: Reach the end of the path.
starting_code:
# One move is wrong. Fix it.
wizard.move_left()
wizard.move_left()
wizard.move_down()
wizard.move_right()
hints: Read the code from top to bottom.
Watch what your wizard does when you press Run.
The very last step goes the wrong way.
intro: I left a note in this program to help you. Read the note first. Then find the mistake and fix it.
outro: You fixed the program perfectly! Notes make everything much easier to understand.
learned: Now you know that a note, which programmers call a comment, helps explain a program.
